faq.q: What can this photo generator make from one product photo?
faq.a: A new product image from one clear photo you upload. Typical results are a listing image, a room scene, a detail, or a square ad. You review the file before you publish.
Upload a product photo or describe the image, choose the photo type and the scene, then generate a square result. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: Is there a free way to make these photos?
faq.a: There is no free plan on the pricing page. Each image uses 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Are the photos usable on a product page?
faq.a: Yes, for listing, lifestyle, and ad images. Check each result against the product you ship so color, shape, and details still match.

faq.q: What kinds of photos can I make?
faq.a: Clean listing, lifestyle, on-model, close detail, or social ad images. Every result starts from the photo or the description you provide.

faq.q: What do I skip compared with a studio day?
faq.a: You skip the studio booking and the model call time. You still check the image, and you still add prices yourself after download.

Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use on your store and ads, under our terms. That does not clear a source photo you do not own. The notes in [AI product photography](page:blog-ai-product-photography-guide) explain that check.

faq.q: Can I add a price or a logo on the photo?
faq.a: Add prices, offers, and logo text in your editor after download. Generated lettering can be wrong. [Shopify product photos](page:plat-shopify) shows one place those files can go.

faq.q: Where are the AI product photo templates?
faq.a: Browse [product ad templates](page:templates) for packshots, lifestyle scenes, and ad layouts. Then upload your product photo here and describe the scene.
